disposition_reason: The original Figure 6B endpoint has a verified ordered metric, reported 72.71% baseline and author-code route. Complete source cohort/fold admission, a rerun baseline, meaningful effect, uncertainty and fixed execution budgets are still missing, so this is a design rather than a ready improvement task.

source_paper.title: Population analyses reveal heterogenous encoding in the medial prefrontal cortex during naturalistic foraging

evidence.locator: Figure 6A,B and Results: Population activities in the E-zone encode success and failure of avoidance; Methods: Head-withdrawal-type classification
evidence.supports: Reports avoidance-versus-escape balanced accuracy of 72.71%, shuffled 51.62%, across 40 sessions, using peri-withdrawal neural activity and stratified fivefold evaluation.

evidence.locator: EventClassifier.fitBNB; X/y loading and clipping; HW label selection; Batch_EventClassifier
evidence.supports: Defines seed 622 stratified fivefold splits, BernoulliNB uniform priors, pooled out-of-fold probabilities, 0.5 threshold and mean session accuracy. Code uses an unseeded generator for shuffled labels.

evidence.locator: Generate Gaussian Kernel; normalization; Divide by EVENT Marker; Separate Avoid and Escape
evidence.supports: Defines whole-session normalization, per-event smoothing, event labels and class-block row serialization; preprocessing is transductive with respect to later folds.
Freezes [-1000,+1000] ms, 50 ms bins, kernel-size 1000 and standard deviation 100; this is 40 bins per unit.
Original classifier archive contains per-session MATLAB X/y matrices; labels 3/4 encode avoidance/escape head withdrawals. Inventory lists the 15.09 MB EventClassificationData_4C.zip.

target.description: Figure 6B within-recording discrimination of avoidance head withdrawal versus escape head withdrawal from the same two-second peri-event population activity. This is retrospective peri-event decoding, not the separate early-prediction time-course in Figure 6C.

dataset.description: Dryad doi:10.5061/dryad.v9s4mw78c January 14 2026 release, EventClassificationData_4C.zip, preserving its processed per-session X/y representation. Complete archive identities and contents still require admission.

cohort.description: The published endpoint contains all 40 recording sessions. An authenticated archive-member roster and complete original rat/session identity mapping have not been read in this audit, so the exact 40-session inclusion remains an execution gate.

split.description: Author code specifies within-session StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=622), each original HW row held out once. Exact rows, source package-version effects and historical assignment parity need authenticated inputs; preserve these source folds rather than substituting animal/episode holdouts.

inputs.description: All released X columns and all label-3/4 rows in every original session; training labels map 3=avoidance and 4=escape. Test labels remain protected during candidate execution. Each neuron contributes all 40 original bins.

preprocessing.description: Preserve source whole-session standardized, Gaussian-smoothed peri-event features and clipping to [-5,5]; BernoulliNB binarizes at zero. Whole-session normalization and symmetric smoothing remain disclosed; training-only preprocessing cannot undo this original transductive representation.

metric.description: Balanced accuracy per session = 0.5*(avoidance recall + escape recall), after pooling all five out-of-fold predictions and thresholding escape probability at >=0.5. Do not average fold accuracies or substitute probability reconstruction error.

aggregation.description: Arithmetic mean of complete session balanced accuracies across all 40 original sessions; the author batch routine computes the mean of its per-session HW accuracies. Session weighting and animal-level uncertainty are distinct.

comparison.primary_metric: Equal-session mean Figure 6B avoidance/escape balanced accuracy on original fivefold OOF predictions

published_baseline.description: Published real-label Figure 6B result is 72.71% = 0.7271. The 51.62% shuffled value is a separate historical control with unseeded randomness, not the primary performance target.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Source-authorized route is the pinned EventClassifier HW branch with all 40 sessions and original source folds. No numeric author rerun has been established by this audit; the local probability reference remains a calibration implementation.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful balanced-accuracy gain must be justified from original cohort variability and the behavioral interpretation before final testing. No arbitrary percentage-point margin is adopted.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired candidate-versus-author session differences and an uncertainty procedure that accounts for repeated sessions from the same rat; retain the original equal-session point estimate.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Rat for biological replication; sessions are nested observations.
uncertainty.rationale: The reported t(39) does not certify 40 independent animals. Without the complete rat/session ledger, neither a cluster-based interval nor a population claim is admitted.

paper_win_requires: Authenticate all 40 original sessions, exact source folds and input preprocessing; no easier subset, changed time window or altered population.
Establish a reproduced author BernoulliNB result and reconcile it with published 0.7271 before judging candidate performance.
Exceed the source result on the original balanced-accuracy endpoint with predeclared meaningful effect and valid paired uncertainty; a fit-to-reference score is not success.
Freeze the candidate before final original-fold scoring, protect labels and prevent class-block row order or original indices from leaking the target.
Treat nested logistic controls as separate competence checks, and any whole-animal, episode or new-split result as an extension rather than the paper win.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was verified; source-paper results and any future author rerun remain separate comparators.

episode.improvement_loop: Once admitted, let candidates iterate using training data and internal validation confined to each original outer training partition; final outer-fold labels and other folds' fitted state remain unavailable.
episode.candidate_freeze: Commit code, feature handling, hyperparameter-selection rule, probability threshold, all budgets and uncertainty rule before original outer-test feedback. Persist exact authenticated fold identities.
episode.final_evaluation: Evaluate every original HW row once out of fold and all 40 session scores against the source-authorized BernoulliNB rerun and published 0.7271. Report calibration and other comparator results separately.
episode.baseline_policy: Paper score, rerun author BNB, unseeded historical shuffle, any deterministic new shuffle and local logistic reference are separately named. A changed split cannot validate a claim against 0.7271.

blocking_issues: Authenticate the complete 40-member scientific archive and rat/session mapping without selecting successful sessions.
Recover or validate exact original fold assignments and source environment; run and independently audit the author baseline.
Specify a task-justified minimum effect and uncertainty rule using valid independent units.
Set concrete access/compute budgets and validate the protected complete-cohort evaluator; existing design/resource estimates are not operational admission.

legacy.notes: Preserve the complete foraging-programme implementation. Native out-of-fold probability fidelity and seeded-control reconstruction remain calibration only. The existing separately proposed hidden-label decoder design does not yet establish an empirical paper improvement or operational readiness.
